title: Substitution
description: A class to specify the conditions under which the Security Provider can substitute posted collateral. The details required for 'Legacy' agreements are substantially different to those required for newer agreements; where the agreement is a 1994 or 1995 CSA, or 1995 CSD, the legacyConsent attribute needs to be used which contains additional values beyond a simple true/false value.

needsConsent.description: The election as to whether the Pledgor/Obligor/Chargor must obtain the Secured Partys consent for any collateral substitution.

substitutionDateLanguage.description: Substitution Date has the meaning specified in Paragraph4(d)(ii), unless otherwise specified.

specificConsentLanguage.description: Specific consent language might be specified by the parties.

legacyConsent.description: The process for substituting/exchanging one form of collateral held by a party for a different form of collateral, used with legacy agreements.
